title: Candy Cathedral Ballet
description: A surreal scene featuring three young ballerinas in black and pink tutus interacting with a whimsical candy landscape. One kneels on a patterned stone path eating sweets, another dances amid giant lollipops and candy clusters, while a third floats upside down underwater surrounded by bubbles, all set before a towering gothic cathedral with a rose window made of pink candy under a purple twilight sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of three ballerinas in black leotards and fluffy pink tutus. One kneels on an ornate stone path eating candy, another dances with arms outstretched among giant swirling lollipops and candy piles, the third floats upside down underwater with bubbles. Behind them stands a massive gothic cathedral with pink and white striped columns and a large circular pink candy rose window under a purple cloudy sky with floating candy canes.
